recentItems.title: Severe Storms to Threaten Thanksgiving Travel. What You Need to Know - November 24
recentItems.description:
Jay O'Brien has the latest on the storm bearing down on the East Coast, and how it could prove to challenge holiday travelers while also being a threat for the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade. Plus, two men were arrested after a suspected break-in at Princess William and Princess Kate's home, new revelations from the late Pope Francis's new book, a ninth-measles related death reported in Pennsylvania, and the annual turkey pardoning takes place at the White House, along with other headlines you need to know today.

00:32: THANKSGIVING TRAVEL RUSH: A powerful storm could disrupt holiday travel.
02:48: NVIDIA FALLOUT: Jensen Huang is back in charge at Nvidia after President Trump personally intervened to get him reinstated.
03:53: RUDY G. MEDAL: Rudy Giuliani was awarded The Presidential Medal of Freedom.
04:23: PRINCE WILLIAM HOME BREAK-IN: Masked intruders reportedly broke into the country home of Prince William and Princess Catherine.
05:05: PA 9TH MEASLES DEATH: Pennsylvania officials confirmed the state's ninth measles-related death this year.
05:25: AIRBAG RECALL: More than one million Toyota and Honda vehicles are being recalled because of potentially defective airbags.
05:53: POPE BOOK: New details from Pope Francis's new book called 'The Private Diary of Pope Francis.'
06:21: WHITE HOUSE TURKEY PARDON: President Trump prepares to pardon two turkeys at the White House.
